Question Choices: Multiply 1 1/3 x 2 1/4. Write the result as mixed number
Hints: Convert mixed numbers to improper fractions, multiply numerators and denominators, then simplify.
Solution: 1 1/3 x 2 1/4 = (4/3) x (9/4) = 36/12. Divide numerator and denominator by 12: 36/12 = 3. Simplified result: 3.

Question Choices: Multiply 1 5/8 x 2 2/3. Write the result as mixed number
Hints: Convert mixed numbers to improper fractions, multiply numerators and denominators, then simplify.
Solution: 1 5/8 x 2 2/3 = (13/8) x (8/3) = 104/24. Divide numerator and denominator by 8: 104/24 = 13/3. 13 / 3 gives quotient 4, remainder 1; mixed number 4 1/3.

Question Choices: Multiply 2 1/5 x 1 4/11. Write the result as mixed number
Hints: Convert mixed numbers to improper fractions, multiply numerators and denominators, then simplify.
Solution: 2 1/5 x 1 4/11 = (11/5) x (15/11) = 165/55. Divide numerator and denominator by 55: 165/55 = 3. Simplified result: 3.

Question Choices: Each batch of cookies requires 1 3/4 cups of sugar. A bakery uses 3 1/2 batches to fulfill an order. How many cups of sugar do they use in total?
Hints: Convert mixed numbers to improper fractions, multiply numerators and denominators, then simplify.
Solution: 1 3/4 x 3 1/2 = (7/4) x (7/2) = 49/8. 49 / 8 gives quotient 6, remainder 1; mixed number 6 1/8. Answer: 6 1/8 cups.
